summary: Targeted retest of the iteration 3 fixes, run on a 375x667 viewport against the public URL. All 6 items pass. (1) Admin Fees: when Convenience fee is cleared, Save shows the error toast 'Enter a value for "Platform convenience fee (₹)"', no PUT /admin/config is sent, and the config read back over the API is unchanged. (2) A rejected food shop shows 'Not approved' with a close-circle icon, 'Reason: Address unclear', the corrected FSSAI input and the 'Fix & resubmit for review' button. Resubmitting with a new FSSAI number changes the card to 'Pending review' and saves the new FSSAI as submitted. (3) After a rider claims, picks up and delivers with OTP, 'Delivered · back to jobs' returns to /rider/active and only one tablist is visible. (4) The header label reads GATHRCART RIDER on rider tabs, GATHRCART ADMIN on admin screens and GATHRCART PARTNER on seller screens. (5) Opening /login while logged in redirects to /partner, /admin or /rider for seller, admin and rider. (6) Backend test_rider_admin.py prints RIDER/ADMIN OK and RESUBMIT OK.
critical_code_review_comments: rider/order/[id].tsx uses the generic Header, not PartnerHeader, so the GATHRCART RIDER label does not show on the order detail screen. This is OK, just noting it.

shop.tsx resubmit: if the seller types a partial FSSAI number (not 14 digits), PUT /seller/shop/fssai returns 422 and the backend message appears as a toast. There is no inline check on the client. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_Rejected Kitchen seller with a random 93xxxxxxxx phone, and ran seed_rider_admin_ui.py (sfx 3064777). Then onboarded, verified and set online the TEST_UI Rider. Cleanup: rejected all 3 pending/rejected TEST shops with note TEST_cleanup, closed the 3 TEST seller shops, and set the rider unavailable. The approved TEST_UI shop1 is closed but still approved. The admin fee config was not changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: seed_rider_admin_ui.py does not create a rider. Use the rider_phone from /tmp/ui_seed.json: log in as rider, then the admin calls POST /admin/riders/{id}/review approve, then the rider calls PUT /rider/availability {available:true}. After claiming, the app goes to /rider/active; tap rider-job-* to open the order. Click the OTP confirm button with a JS click. Use seed_rejected_shop.py to get a rejected food shop (writes /tmp/rejected_shop.json).
